fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company currently expects to consume approximately 2.2 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2024.

instrument_type_details.notes: As of 12/31/2023, fuel derivative instruments consist solely of option contracts ($223M Level 3). Cash collateral held from counterparties: $50M. Hedges extend through 2026. pct_hedged_next_year ~57% estimated as 1,265M gallons / 2,200M gallons expected 2024 consumption. Longer-dated positions (2025-2026) are Brent crude oil only; 2024 positions include both WTI and Brent.

warnings: pct_hedged_next_year (57%) is estimated as 1,265M gallons / 2,200M gallons expected 2024 consumption; not explicitly stated in filing.
Volumes are maximum economic hedge and may vary based on market prices and flight schedule.
